verses.original: Καὶ ὑμᾶς ὄντας νεκροὺς τοῖς παραπτώμασιν καὶ ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai hymas ontas nekrous tois paraptōmasin kai tais hamartiais hymōn
verses.literal: And you were dead in your trespasses and sins
verses.literalPt: E VOS vivificou, estando vós mortos em ofensas e pecados,

verses.original: ἐν αἷς ποτε περιεπατήσατε κατὰ τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ κόσμου τούτου κατὰ τὸν ἄρχοντα τῆς ἐξουσίας τοῦ ἀέρος τοῦ πνεύματος τοῦ νῦν ἐνεργοῦντος ἐν τοῖς υἱοῖς τῆς ἀπειθείας
verses.transliteration: en hais pote periepatēsate kata ton aiōna tou kosmou toutou kata ton archonta tēs exousias tou aeros tou pneumatos tou nyn energountos en tois huiois tēs apeitheias
verses.literal: in which you used to walk when you conformed to the ways of this world and of the ruler of the power of the air the spirit who is now at work in the sons of disobedience
verses.literalPt: Em que noutro tempo andastes segundo o curso deste mundo, segundo o príncipe das potestades do ar, do espírito que agora opera nos filhos da desobediência.

verses.original: ἐν οἷς καὶ ἡμεῖς πάντες ἀνεστράφημέν ποτε ἐν ταῖς ἐπιθυμίαις τῆς σαρκὸς ἡμῶν ποιοῦντες τὰ θελήματα τῆς σαρκὸς καὶ τῶν διανοιῶν καὶ ἤμεθα τέκνα φύσει ὀργῆς ὡς καὶ οἱ λοιποί
verses.transliteration: en hois kai hēmeis pantes anestraphēmen pote en tais epithymiais tēs sarkos hēmōn poiountes ta thelēmata tēs sarkos kai tōn dianoiōn kai ēmetha tekna physei orgēs hōs kai hoi loipoi
verses.literal: All of us also lived among them at one time fulfilling the cravings of our flesh and indulging its desires and thoughts - - Like the rest we were by nature children of wrath
verses.literalPt: Entre os quais todos nós também antes andávamos nos desejos da nossa carne, fazendo a vontade da carne e dos pensamentos; e éramos por natureza filhos da ira, como os outros também.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Θεὸς πλούσιος ὢν ἐν ἐλέει διὰ τὴν πολλὴν ἀγάπην αὐτοῦ ἣν ἠγάπησεν ἡμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Ho de Theos plousios ōn en eleei dia tēn pollēn agapēn autou hēn ēgapēsen hēmas
verses.literal: But because of His great love for us . . . . . . God who is rich in mercy
verses.literalPt: Mas Deus, que é riquíssimo em misericórdia, pelo seu muito amor com que nos amou,

verses.original: καὶ ὄντας ἡμᾶς νεκροὺς τοῖς παραπτώμασιν συνεζωοποίησεν τῷ Χριστῷ χάριτί ἐστε σεσῳσμένοι
verses.transliteration: kai ontas hēmas nekrous tois paraptōmasin synezōopoiēsen tō Christō chariti este sesōsmenoi
verses.literal: made us alive with Christ even when we were dead in our trespasses It is by grace you have been saved
verses.literalPt: Estando nós ainda mortos em nossas ofensas, nos vivificou juntamente com Cristo (pela graça sois salvos),

verses.original: καὶ συνήγειρεν καὶ συνεκάθισεν ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai synēgeiren kai synekathisen en tois epouraniois en Christō Iēsou
verses.literal: And God raised us up with Christ and seated us with Him in the heavenly realms in Christ Jesus
verses.literalPt: E nos ressuscitou juntamente com ele e nos fez assentar nos lugares celestiais, em Cristo Jesus;

verses.original: ἵνα ἐνδείξηται ἐν τοῖς αἰῶσιν τοῖς ἐπερχομένοις τὸ ὑπερβάλλον πλοῦτος τῆς χάριτος αὐτοῦ ἐν χρηστότητι ἐφ’ ἡμᾶς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: hina endeixētai en tois aiōsin tois eperchomenois to hyperballon ploutos tēs charitos autou en chrēstotēti eph’ hēmas en Christō Iēsou
verses.literal: in order that in the coming ages He might display the surpassing riches of His grace demonstrated by His kindness to us in Christ Jesus
verses.literalPt: Para mostrar nos séculos vindouros as abundantes riquezas da sua graça pela sua benignidade para conosco em Cristo Jesus.

verses.original: Τῇ γὰρ χάριτί ἐστε σεσῳσμένοι διὰ πίστεως καὶ τοῦτο οὐκ ἐξ ὑμῶν Θεοῦ τὸ δῶρον
verses.transliteration: Tē gar chariti este sesōsmenoi dia pisteōs kai touto ouk ex hymōn Theou to dōron
verses.literal: For it is by grace you have been saved through faith and this not from yourselves it is the gift of God
verses.literalPt: Porque pela graça sois salvos, por meio da fé; e isto não vem de vós, é dom de Deus.

verses.original: οὐκ ἐξ ἔργων ἵνα μή τις καυχήσηται
verses.transliteration: ouk ex ergōn hina mē tis kauchēsētai
verses.literal: not by works so that no one can boast
verses.literalPt: Não vem das obras, para que ninguém se glorie;

verses.original: αὐτοῦ γάρ ἐσμεν ποίημα κτισθέντες ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ ἐπὶ ἔργοις ἀγαθοῖς οἷς προητοίμασεν ὁ Θεὸς ἵνα ἐν αὐτοῖς περιπατήσωμεν
verses.transliteration: autou gar esmen poiēma ktisthentes en Christō Iēsou epi ergois agathois hois proētoimasen ho Theos hina en autois peripatēsōmen
verses.literal: For we are God’s workmanship created in Christ Jesus to do good works which God prepared in advance as our way of life . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Porque somos feitura sua, criados em Cristo Jesus para as boas obras, as quais Deus preparou para que andássemos nelas.

verses.original: Διὸ μνημονεύετε ὅτι ποτὲ ὑμεῖς τὰ ἔθνη ἐν σαρκί οἱ λεγόμενοι ἀκροβυστία ὑπὸ τῆς λεγομένης περιτομῆς ἐν σαρκὶ χειροποιήτου
verses.transliteration: Dio mnēmoneuete hoti pote hymeis ta ethnē en sarki hoi legomenoi akrobystia hypo tēs legomenēs peritomēs en sarki cheiropoiētou
verses.literal: Therefore remember that formerly you who are Gentiles in the flesh and called uncircumcised by the so-called circumcision (that done in the body by human hands)
verses.literalPt: Portanto, lembrai-vos de que vós noutro tempo éreis gentios na carne, e chamados incircuncisão pelos que na carne se chamam circuncisão feita pela mão dos homens;

verses.original: ὅτι ἦτε τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ χωρὶς Χριστοῦ ἀπηλλοτριωμένοι τῆς πολιτείας τοῦ Ἰσραὴλ καὶ ξένοι τῶν διαθηκῶν τῆς ἐπαγγελίας ἐλπίδα μὴ ἔχοντες καὶ ἄθεοι ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ
verses.transliteration: hoti ēte tō kairō ekeinō chōris Christou apēllotriōmenoi tēs politeias tou Israēl kai xenoi tōn diathēkōn tēs epangelias elpida mē echontes kai atheoi en tō kosmō
verses.literal: remember that at that time you were separate from Christ alienated from the commonwealth of Israel and strangers to the covenants of the promise without . . . hope and without God in the world
verses.literalPt: Que naquele tempo estáveis sem Cristo, separados da comunidade de Israel, e estranhos às alianças da promessa, não tendo esperança, e sem Deus no mundo.

verses.original: νυνὶ δὲ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ ὑμεῖς οἵ ποτε ὄντες μακρὰν ἐγενήθητε ἐγγὺς ἐν τῷ αἵματι τοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: nyni de en Christō Iēsou hymeis hoi pote ontes makran egenēthēte engys en tō haimati tou Christou
verses.literal: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far away have been brought near through the blood of Christ
verses.literalPt: Mas agora em Cristo Jesus, vós, que antes estáveis longe, já pelo sangue de Cristo chegastes perto.

verses.original: Αὐτὸς γάρ ἐστιν ἡ εἰρήνη ἡμῶν ὁ ποιήσας τὰ ἀμφότερα ἓν καὶ τὸ μεσότοιχον τοῦ φραγμοῦ λύσας τὴν ἔχθραν
verses.transliteration: Autos gar estin hē eirēnē hēmōn ho poiēsas ta amphotera hen kai to mesotoichon tou phragmou lysas tēn echthran
verses.literal: For He Himself is our peace who has made the two one and has torn down the dividing wall of hostility
verses.literalPt: Porque ele é a nossa paz, o qual de ambos os povos fez um; e, derrubando a parede de separação que estava no meio,

verses.original: ἐν τῇ σαρκὶ αὐτοῦ τὸν νόμον τῶν ἐντολῶν ἐν δόγμασιν καταργήσας ἵνα τοὺς δύο κτίσῃ ἐν αὑτῷ εἰς ἕνα καινὸν ἄνθρωπον ποιῶν εἰρήνην
verses.transliteration: en tē sarki autou ton nomon tōn entolōn en dogmasin katargēsas hina tous dyo ktisē en hautō eis hena kainon anthrōpon poiōn eirēnēn
verses.literal: by abolishing in His flesh the law of commandments and decrees He did this to create in Himself one new man out of the two thus making peace
verses.literalPt: Na sua carne desfez a inimizade, isto é, a lei dos mandamentos, que consistia em ordenanças, para criar em si mesmo dos dois um novo homem, fazendo a paz,

verses.original: καὶ ἀποκαταλλάξῃ τοὺς ἀμφοτέρους ἐν ἑνὶ σώματι τῷ Θεῷ διὰ τοῦ σταυροῦ ἀποκτείνας τὴν ἔχθραν ἐν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: kai apokatallaxē tous amphoterous en heni sōmati tō Theō dia tou staurou apokteinas tēn echthran en autō
verses.literal: and reconciling both of them to God in one body through the cross by which He put to death their hostility
verses.literalPt: E pela cruz reconciliar ambos com Deus em um corpo, matando com ela as inimizades.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐλθὼν εὐηγγελίσατο εἰρήνην ὑμῖν τοῖς μακρὰν καὶ εἰρήνην τοῖς ἐγγύς
verses.transliteration: Kai elthōn euēngelisato eirēnēn hymin tois makran kai eirēnēn tois engys
verses.literal: He came and preached peace to you who were far away and peace to those who were near
verses.literalPt: E, vindo, ele evangelizou a paz, a vós que estáveis longe, e aos que estavam perto;

verses.original: ὅτι δι’ αὐτοῦ ἔχομεν τὴν προσαγωγὴν οἱ ἀμφότεροι ἐν ἑνὶ Πνεύματι πρὸς τὸν Πατέρα
verses.transliteration: hoti di’ autou echomen tēn prosagōgēn hoi amphoteroi en heni Pneumati pros ton Patera
verses.literal: For through Him we both have access to the Father by one Spirit
verses.literalPt: Porque por ele ambos temos acesso ao Pai em um mesmo Espírito.

verses.original: Ἄρα οὖν οὐκέτι ἐστὲ ξένοι καὶ πάροικοι ἀλλὰ ἐστὲ συμπολῖται τῶν ἁγίων καὶ οἰκεῖοι τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Ara oun ouketi este xenoi kai paroikoi alla este sympolitai tōn hagiōn kai oikeioi tou Theou
verses.literal: Therefore . . . you are no longer strangers and foreigners but fellow citizens with the saints and members of God’s household . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Assim que já não sois estrangeiros, nem forasteiros, mas concidadãos dos santos, e da família de Deus;

verses.original: ἐποικοδομηθέντες ἐπὶ τῷ θεμελίῳ τῶν ἀποστόλων καὶ προφητῶν ὄντος ἀκρογωνιαίου αὐτοῦ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: epoikodomēthentes epi tō themeliō tōn apostolōn kai prophētōn ontos akrogōniaiou autou Christou Iēsou
verses.literal: built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets with Christ Jesus Himself as the cornerstone
verses.literalPt: Edificados sobre o fundamento dos apóstolos e dos profetas, de que Jesus Cristo é a principal pedra da esquina;

verses.original: ἐν ᾧ πᾶσα οἰκοδομὴ συναρμολογουμένη αὔξει εἰς ναὸν ἅγιον ἐν Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: en hō pasa oikodomē synarmologoumenē auxei eis naon hagion en Kyriō
verses.literal: In Him the whole building is fitted together and grows into a holy temple in the Lord
verses.literalPt: No qual todo o edifício, bem ajustado, cresce para templo santo no Senhor.

verses.original: ἐν ᾧ καὶ ὑμεῖς συνοικοδομεῖσθε εἰς κατοικητήριον τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐν Πνεύματι
verses.transliteration: en hō kai hymeis synoikodomeisthe eis katoikētērion tou Theou en Pneumati
verses.literal: And in Him you too are being built together into a dwelling place for God in His Spirit
verses.literalPt: No qual também vós juntamente sois edificados para morada de Deus em Espírito.
